scope: Host-qualified semantic publication and native ID/reference ownership audit. Fix bounded admission/lifetime issues; document full native remapping and platform lifecycle migrations.
done_conditions: Host owner reaches native/browser publication through the shared Accessibility contract.
Foreign owner with identical live document/mount cannot activate a published request; requeue cannot rebind it.
Disposed host refuses direct/raw semantic activation; owner tokens retain no host.
Native ID migration documents full reference and guest boundaries without claiming it fixed.
Affected native tests and Wasm/embedding compilation pass; failed gates retained.
Concurrent WIP preserved; committed prior audit pushed; own temporary worktree removed after integration.
Native attachment rejects another handle without changing the original; the same handle is idempotent, and native host creation propagates attachment errors.
